pause_answered.description: contracts of this chain that answer paused() or isPaused() (non-stale records); null when pause_state.json is missing: not read, never zero

roles_read.description: contracts with a secondary role (pauser, guardian, curator ...) read by side_roles.json; null when the file is missing

admin_safes_nonce_read.description: admin Safes of this chain whose nonce was read (safe_activity.json, non-stale); null when the file is missing

admin_role_probed.description: unreadable contracts of this chain probed for their admin role (admin_probe.json); null when the file is missing

held_read.description: contracts with a money figure from their own totalAssets() instead of a DefiLlama protocol
